subject: english-language
title: Ethos, Pathos, Logos
welcome_lead: Three ancient routes to convincing a reader.
meta_desc: KS3 English Language adventure on Aristotle's three appeals.
final_note: You can now spot ethos, pathos and logos in a text.

walkthroughs.body_html: Best speeches blend all three: a credible speaker (ethos) tells a moving story (pathos) and backs it with stats (logos).
Different audiences respond to different appeals. Scientists may want logos; charity readers may need pathos. Match the mix.
